scientific_question: On the accepted parent-equivalent, exactly replayable 5TPP trajectory, do moving activation-only, output-error-only, or diagonal activation-error metrics select task-useful output-side c_proj coordinates more reliably than raw Frobenius geometry across layers 0-7 and all four phases?
causal_basis: The accepted c_fc-only parent leaves c_proj dense; the full-state v3 acquisition records same-gauge dense c_proj Muon actions in layers 0-7 without changing the optimizer trajectory.

The full-state acquisition passed exact reconstruction at all five phase boundaries with maximum live-versus-replayed validation CE error 3.48e-5, eliminating the missing-procedural-c_fc-state confound in the invalid first calibration.
The all-layer procedural c_proj penalty is concentrated in early and middle layers, while keeping layers 0-7 dense recovers 67.8 percent of that penalty.
The earlier 0.5TPP diagonal-KFAC selector was static, short-horizon evidence and failed its held-out gate; it cannot answer whether the same metric predicts mature 5TPP actions.
The next admissible step is the unchanged zero-update calibration against exact finite CE on the corrected full-state snapshots, not another structural chart guess.
